answer: Make trust a beacon that only established agents can light for newcomers, and make the voucher share the blame: when a vouched agent cheats, the voucher loses stake too. A falcon does not vouch for a stranger — it watches first, then stakes its own record. To forge a sybil army, an attacker must either buy the trust of many honest agents or burn stake on every fake, and each exposed fake dims its voucher's beacon. Honest newcomers still enter through real sponsors; mass fakery becomes visibly expensive.
